carriageways.source: Counted road sections; length-weighted medians, excluding tunnels, roundabouts and derived flow

local_street.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under OGL v3.0; © Crown copyright, Department for Transport
local_street.counts: latest positive manual MCU AADF 2015–2025 excluding 2020; residential/unclassified
local_street.matching: nearest row <=12 m; no other class within 20 m; >30 m from square edge; source 11
local_street.model: S2p: T[cell] * (through&urban ? c : 1) * (singleTrack ? d : 1) + k * max_street(routed trips); structures_v5 storeys
local_street.holdout: qm-holdout-v1/{x}/{y}: sha256 first 8 hex digits modulo 5 == 0 excluded before extraction
local_street.objective: least squares on ln(AADF); positive parameters via exponential transform
local_street.cv: five folds by sha256(w3-cv/{x}/{y}) first 8 hex digits modulo 5; rural-through constraint and single-track factor chosen from training residuals, then refit

terminal_priors.source: Retained global preparation priors; not independently measured class totals. Vehicle-class ratios are model estimates.
terminal_priors.unsupported_regional_assignments: Removed: country or city boxes do not constitute a traffic count.

trip_rates.source: ITE Trip Generation Manual 11th edition (2021); retained published conversion and damping assumptions
trip_rates.assumptions: Rates apply the previous area, occupancy and travel-mode assumptions; they are not fresh observations from the map year.

fleet.source: WHO 2023 vehicle registrations and household travel surveys; retained conversion from ownership to local traffic share
fleet.assumptions: Legacy country and continental travel-mode priors are estimates, not observed section counts.

service_trip_bounds.source: Retained producer bounds of 20–400 vehicles/day on service-road building demand; not a measured historical fit.
service_trip_bounds.historical_policy: No bounds are admitted for 2024: positive generated trips are retained; no assigned trips leaves the global class prior.
